comment: Regenstrief Institute, LOINC's steward, is named alongside SNOMED International, SNOMED CT’s steward and WHO-FIC as an anchor body for federation and international coordination — the only place LOINC's governing organization is identified. This requirement is classed “Recommended,” not “Required,” and the text does not describe how synchronization with LOINC releases, or submission of national term requests to Regenstrief, would work in practice.
